poem:
金风一缕送秋凉，稻熟林红满野芳。
收获时节宜收束，且将新岁问青阳。
interpretation:
主运势正丰，所谋将有所成。宜把握收获期，整理过去，规划未来。
问事业者秋实可摘，问情感者当下是黄金期。
allusion: 《诗经·蒹葭》：「蒹葭苍苍，白露为霜。」秋气清朗，示人收获之际，亦是收束之时。
modernNotes: 心态：知足常乐，不奢不躁
人际：分享所得，可成善缘
节奏：先收后藏，蓄势来春
提醒：勿因已得而忘未备

zh_TW.title: 金風送爽
zh_TW.poem:
金風一縷送秋涼，稻熟林紅滿野芳。
收穫時節宜收束，且將新歲問青陽。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢正豐，所謀將有所成。宜把握收穫期，整理過去，規劃未來。
問事業者秋實可摘，問情感者當下是黃金期。
zh_TW.allusion: 《詩經·蒹葈》：「蒹葈蒼蒼，白露為霜。」秋氣清朗，示人收穫之際，亦是收束之時。
modernNotes: 心態：知足常樂，不奢不躁
人際：分享所得，可成善緣
節奏：先收後藏，蓄勢來春
提醒：勿因已得而忘未備

en.title: Golden Wind, Autumn Cool
en.poem:
One thread of golden wind brings autumn's cool; the rice is ripe, the forest red, the wildlands full of fragrance.
In the season of harvest, gather in—what is the coming year to ask of the spring sun?
en.interpretation:
Fortune is full. What you plan shall come to fruit. Take the harvest time, gather the past, plan the future.
For those asking about work, the autumn fruit can be picked. For those asking about relationships, the present is the golden time.
en.allusion: Book of Songs · Jian Jia: "The reeds are lush, the white dew turns to frost." The clear air of autumn teaches that the season of harvest is also the time of gathering in.
modernNotes: Action: Harvest time. Seize the fruits.
Mindset: Contentment is the constant joy. Not greedy, not restless.
Relationships: Share what you have gained—it can become a good bond.
Pace: First gather, then store. Save strength for the coming spring.
Reminder: Do not forget to prepare for what is not yet ready, just because you have gained.

title: 林深人静
poem:
林深人静鸟声稀，独坐幽篁听翠微。
心远地偏尘自远，一窗山色自忘机。
interpretation:
主运势内敛，宜潜心自修。当下之静非为蛰伏，乃为厚积。
问躁进者宜止步，问深修者得其乐。
allusion: 王维《竹里馆》：「独坐幽篁里，弹琴复长啸。深林人不知，明月来相照。」林深人静，示人内省之乐。
modernNotes: 行动：闭门读书，反观内心
节奏：慢节奏，重质不重量

zh_TW.title: 林深人靜
zh_TW.poem:
林深人靜鳥聲稀，獨坐幽篁聽翠微。
心遠地偏塵自遠，一窗山色自忘機。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢內斂，宜潛心自修。當下之靜非為蟄伏，乃為厚積。
問躁進者宜止步，問深修者得其樂。
zh_TW.allusion: 王維《竹里館》：「獨坐幽篁裡，彈琴復長嘯。深林人不知，明月來相照。」林深人靜，示人內省之樂。
modernNotes: 行動：閉門讀書，反觀內心
節奏：慢節奏，重質不重量

en.title: Deep Forest, Quiet Mind
en.poem:
The forest is deep, the people still, the birdsong rare; alone I sit in the dark bamboo, listening to the green.
When the heart is far and the place is off the beaten track, the dust is far of itself; one window of mountain color, and the mind forgets its wiles.
en.interpretation:
Fortune is inward; dive into self-cultivation. The present quiet is not hiding, but gathering.
For those asking about rushing forward, stop your step. For those asking about deep cultivation, you find your joy.
en.allusion: Wang Wei's "Bamboo Lodge": "Alone I sit in the dark bamboo, pluck the lute, and sing long. The deep forest knows no one; the bright moon comes to shine on me." The deep forest's quiet teaches the joy of looking within.
modernNotes: Action: Close the door, read, look within.
Relationships: Choose two or three true friends for deep company.
Pace: A slow pace. Quality over quantity.
Reminder: In stillness, do not forget to observe the outside.

title: 灯火可亲
poem:
一灯如豆坐黄昏，暖意盈怀抵万金。
莫道平居无足道，家人闲处见情深。
interpretation:
主运势平稳，所求在近不在远。珍惜当下所有，便是最大福气。
问事业者稳中求进，问家庭者当下即是。
allusion: 汪曾祺：「家人闲坐，灯火可亲。」平居之乐，示人幸福常在寻常处。
modernNotes: 行动：珍视眼前，不慕高远
人际：陪伴是最长情的告白
节奏：日常节奏，张弛有度

zh_TW.title: 燈火可親
zh_TW.poem:
一燈如豆坐黃昏，暖意盈懷抵萬金。
莫道平居無足道，家人閒處見情深。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢平穩，所求在近不在遠。珍惜當下所有，便是最大福氣。
問事業者穩中求進，問家庭者當下即是。
zh_TW.allusion: 汪曾祺：「家人閒坐，燈火可親。」平居之樂，示人幸福常在尋常處。
modernNotes: 行動：珍視眼前，不慕高遠
人際：陪伴是最長情的告白
節奏：日常節奏，張弛有度

en.title: The Lamplight, Warm and Near
en.poem:
One lamp, bean-sized, sitting at dusk; warmth fills the arms, worth ten thousand gold.
Say not the everyday has nothing to speak—where the family sits at ease, the feeling runs deep.
en.interpretation:
Fortune is steady. What you seek is near, not far. Cherish what is already here—that is the greatest blessing.
For those asking about work, advance steadily. For those asking about family, the present is it.
en.allusion: Wang Zengqi: "The family sits at leisure; the lamplight is warm and dear." The joy of everyday life teaches that happiness is often in the ordinary place.
modernNotes: Action: Cherish what is in front of you. Do not long for the distant.
Relationships: Companionship is the longest告白.
Pace: The everyday pace. Tension and release in measure.
Reminder: Do not wait until you have lost to know its worth.

title: 坐看云起
poem:
行到水穷山尽处，坐看云起意悠然。
得失从来无定数，一蓑烟雨任平生。
interpretation:
主运势转折在即，看似无路，实有新机。宜转换视角，安然处之。
问进者退一步海阔天空，问退者当下即安稳。
allusion: 王维《终南别业》：「行到水穷处，坐看云起时。」绝处未必无路，示人转换视角。
modernNotes: 心态：得失随缘，心自安然
人际：远离消耗，珍惜当下
节奏：放慢脚步，让心跟上

zh_TW.title: 坐看雲起
zh_TW.poem:
行到水窮山盡處，坐看雲起意悠然。
得失從來無定數，一簑煙雨任平生。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢轉折在即，看似無路，實有新機。宜轉換視角，安然處之。
問進者退一步海闊天空，問退者當下即安穩。
zh_TW.allusion: 王維《終南別業》：「行到水窮處，坐看雲起時。」絕處未必無路，示人轉換視角。
modernNotes: 心態：得失隨緣，心自安然
人際：遠離消耗，珍惜當下
節奏：放慢腳步，讓心跟上

en.title: Sit and Watch the Clouds Rise
en.poem:
Walk to where the water ends and the mountain is spent; sit and watch the clouds rise, the mind at ease.
Gain and loss were never fixed—a straw cloak in mist and rain, and the whole life is at will.
en.interpretation:
Fortune is about to turn. What seems to be no way is, in fact, a new opening. Shift the angle; be at peace.
For those asking about advancing, one step back and sea and sky are wide. For those asking about retreat, the present is stable.
en.allusion: Wang Wei's "Dwelling at the Foot of Zhongnan": "Walk to where the water ends; sit and watch the clouds rise." The dead-end is not necessarily no road—teaching us to shift the angle.
modernNotes: Action: Shift the angle. Do not be attached.
Mindset: Gain and loss follow fate. The heart is at peace.
Relationships: Distance from what drains you. Cherish the present.
Pace: Slow the steps. Let the heart catch up.
Reminder: The end of the road is not the end.

title: 清风徐来
poem:
清风徐来水波生，明月徘徊照我心。
万物静观皆自得，扁舟一叶任浮沉。
interpretation:
主运势平稳，宜顺其自然。强求不如顺势，无为亦是有为。
问躁进者宜缓，问等待者时机未至。
allusion: 苏轼《赤壁赋》：「惟江上之清风，与山间之明月，耳得之而为声，目遇之而成色，取之无禁，用之不竭。」清风明月，示人取用无尽。
modernNotes: 心态：万物自得，无求即安
人际：淡交如水，久而益清
节奏：自然节律，不疾不徐
提醒：清风常在，勿失本心

zh_TW.title: 清風徐來
zh_TW.poem:
清風徐來水波生，明月徘徊照我心。
萬物靜觀皆自得，扁舟一葉任浮沉。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢平穩，宜順其自然。強求不如順勢，無為亦是有為。
問躁進者宜緩，問等待者時機未至。
zh_TW.allusion: 蘇軾《赤壁賦》：「惟江上之清風，與山間之明月，耳得之而為聲，目遇之而成色，取之無禁，用之不竭。」清風明月，示人取用無盡。
modernNotes: 心態：萬物自得，無求即安
人際：淡交如水，久而益清
節奏：自然節律，不疾不徐
提醒：清風常在，勿失本心

en.title: A Gentle Breeze Comes Slowly
en.poem:
The gentle breeze comes slowly, the water stirs; the bright moon lingers, shining on my heart.
All things, watched quietly, are content of themselves; one leaf of a skiff, at will it floats or sinks.
en.interpretation:
Fortune is steady. Go with what is natural. Forcing is not as good as following; not-doing is also a doing.
For those asking about rushing forward, slow down. For those asking about waiting, the time is not yet.
en.allusion: Su Shi's "Rhapsody on the Red Cliff": "Only the clear wind on the river and the bright moon in the mountains—ears receive them as sound, eyes meet them as color; take them without prohibition, use them without exhaustion." The clear wind and bright moon teach that there is an inexhaustible supply.
modernNotes: Action: Go with the current. Do not force.
Mindset: All things are content of themselves. No seeking, then peace.
Relationships: Light friendship like water. The longer, the clearer.
Pace: The natural rhythm. Neither fast nor slow.
Reminder: The clear wind is always there. Do not lose the original heart.

title: 冰封三尺
poem:
冰封三尺非一朝，寒气入骨意萧条。
莫怨当下多阻滞，积年沉疴待今朝。
interpretation:
主运势欠佳，困境非一日之积。冰冻三尺非一日之寒，破冰亦非一日可成。
问急务者缓办，问困境者徐图。
allusion: 《增广贤文》：「冰冻三尺，非一日之寒。」示人困境成因深远，宜徐图缓改。
modernNotes: 行动：徐图缓改，不求速破
心态：接纳当下，不怨不躁
人际：远离消耗，深交可信

zh_TW.title: 冰封三尺
zh_TW.poem:
冰封三尺非一朝，寒氣入骨意蕭條。
莫怨當下多阻滯，積年沉疴待今朝。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢欠佳，困境非一日之積。冰凍三尺非一日之寒，破冰亦非一日可成。
問急務者緩辦，問困境者徐圖。
zh_TW.allusion: 《增廣賢文》：「冰凍三尺，非一日之寒。」示人困境成因深遠，宜徐圖緩改。
modernNotes: 行動：徐圖緩改，不求速破
心態：接納當下，不怨不躁
人際：遠離消耗，深交可信

en.title: Ice Sealed, Three Feet Deep
en.poem:
Ice sealed three feet deep is not one morning's work; the cold enters the bone, the spirit is bleak.
Do not blame the present for its many blocks—long-standing ills await this very day.
en.interpretation:
Fortune is poor. The predicament is not one day's making. Ice frozen three feet deep is not one day's cold; breaking it is not one day's work either.
For those asking about urgent matters, do them slowly. For those asking about difficulty, plot the change in due time.
en.allusion: Expanded Wise Sayings: "Three feet of ice is not one day's cold." Teaching that the causes of difficulty run deep; take time to plot the change.
modernNotes: Action: Plot the change slowly. Do not seek a quick break.
Mindset: Accept the present. No complaint, no restlessness.
Relationships: Distance from what drains. Be deep with the trustworthy.
Pace: Very slow. The weight is on accumulation.
Reminder: Ice cannot be broken in one day.

title: 孤舟蓑笠
poem:
孤舟一叶钓寒江，蓑笠翁立风雪中。
世人笑我形单影，我笑世人太匆匆。
interpretation:
主运势孤立，宜独行慎思。独处非为弃世，乃为自清。
问合作者宜缓，问孤行者得其乐。
allusion: 柳宗元《江雪》：「千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭。孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪。」孤舟独钓，示人独处之境。
modernNotes: 行动：独行慎思，戒急戒躁
心态：孤而不孤，心如止水
人际：远离应酬，择一二知己
提醒：孤独非遗世，是自清

zh_TW.title: 孤舟簑笠
zh_TW.poem:
孤舟一葉釣寒江，簑笠翁立風雪中。
世人笑我形單影，我笑世人太匆匆。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢孤立，宜獨行慎思。獨處非為棄世，乃為自清。
問合作者宜緩，問孤行者得其樂。
zh_TW.allusion: 柳宗元《江雪》：「千山鳥飛絕，萬徑人蹤滅。孤舟簑笠翁，獨釣寒江雪。」孤舟獨釣，示人獨處之境。
modernNotes: 行動：獨行慎思，戒急戒躁
心態：孤而不孤，心如止水
人際：遠離應酬，擇一二知己
提醒：孤獨非遺世，是自清

en.title: Lone Skiff, Straw Hat and Cape
en.poem:
A lone skiff of one leaf, fishing the cold river; the old man in straw cape and hat stands in the wind and snow.
The world laughs at my single shadow; I laugh at the world for being in too much of a rush.
en.interpretation:
Fortune is solitary. Walk alone, think carefully. Solitude is not abandoning the world, but cleansing the self.
For those asking about partnership, slow down. For those asking about the solitary path, you find your joy.
en.allusion: Liu Zongyuan's "River Snow": "A thousand mountains—no bird in flight; ten thousand paths—no trace of man. In a lone skiff, an old man in straw cape and hat, fishing alone in the cold river snow." The lone skiff, fishing alone, teaches the state of solitude.
modernNotes: Action: Walk alone, think carefully. Be wary of rush, wary of unrest.
Mindset: Solitary yet not alone. Heart like still water.
Relationships: Distance from social obligations. Choose one or two true friends.
Reminder: Solitude is not abandoning the world; it is cleansing the self.

title: 残雪消融
poem:
残雪一寸寸消融，檐下冰凌落叮咚。
莫道冬深寒未尽，春消息已到墙东。
interpretation:
主运势虽弱，转机已现。困境将解，时机渐至。
问守候者勿失耐心，问待时者已近。
allusion: 陆游：「山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村。」残雪消融，示人困境中有生机。
modernNotes: 行动：再坚持一时，勿放弃
心态：见微知著，信春将至
节奏：等待节律，不可强推
提醒：残雪虽寒，化时已到

zh_TW.title: 殘雪消融
zh_TW.poem:
殘雪一寸寸消融，檐下冰凌落叮咚。
莫道冬深寒未盡，春消息已到牆東。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢雖弱，轉機已現。困境將解，時機漸至。
問守候者勿失耐心，問待時者已近。
zh_TW.allusion: 陸游：「山重水複疑無路，柳暗花明又一村。」殘雪消融，示人困境中有生機。
modernNotes: 行動：再堅持一時，勿放棄
心態：見微知著，信春將至
節奏：等待節律，不可強推
提醒：殘雪雖寒，化時已到

en.title: Lingering Snow Melts
en.poem:
The lingering snow melts, inch by inch; icicles under the eaves fall with a clear plink.
Say not the winter's cold is not yet spent—news of spring has already reached the eastern wall.
en.interpretation:
Though fortune is weak, the turn has come. The difficulty will resolve; the moment draws near.
For those asking about waiting, do not lose patience. For those asking about the right time, it is close.
en.allusion: Lu You: "Where hills bend, streams wind and the pathway seems to end, past dark willows and flowers in bloom lies another village." The lingering snow melting teaches that there is life within the difficulty.
modernNotes: Action: Hold on a little longer. Do not give up.
Mindset: See the small signs. Trust that spring will come.
Relationships: Keep connected. Do not isolate.
Pace: A waiting rhythm. Do not push.
Reminder: Though the lingering snow is cold, the time of melting is here.

title: 长夜待旦
poem:
长夜漫漫何时旦，孤灯一点照心寒。
莫言此夜无穷尽，天意昭昭待晓看。
interpretation:
主运势低谷，宜极守。当下之暗为长夜，待旦自有期。
问急务者宜止，问等待者勿躁。
allusion: 《三国演义》：「大梦谁先觉，平生我自知。」长夜待旦，示人低谷非永远。
modernNotes: 人际：抱团取暖，求可信者

zh_TW.title: 長夜待旦
zh_TW.poem:
長夜漫漫何時旦，孤燈一點照心寒。
莫言此夜無窮盡，天意昭昭待曉看。
zh_TW.interpretation:
主運勢低谷，宜極守。當下之暗為長夜，待旦自有期。
問急務者宜止，問等待者勿躁。
zh_TW.allusion: 《三國演義》：「大夢誰先覺，平生我自知。」長夜待旦，示人低谷非永遠。
modernNotes: 人際：抱團取暖，求可信者

en.title: Long Night, Waiting for Dawn
en.poem:
The long night stretches on—when will dawn come? One point of lonely lamp, lighting the cold heart.
Say not this night has no end; the heavens' will is bright—wait and see at daybreak.
en.interpretation:
Fortune is at its low. Hold most firmly. The present dark is the long night; dawn has its own time.
For those asking about urgent matters, stop. For those asking about waiting, do not be impatient.
en.allusion: Romance of the Three Kingdoms: "Who first wakes from the great dream? My whole life, I know myself." The long night waiting for dawn teaches that the low is not forever.
modernNotes: Action: Hold most firmly. Do not act rashly.
Mindset: Accept the dark. Do not despair.
Relationships: Cluster for warmth. Seek the trustworthy.
Pace: Very slow. Preserve your strength.
Reminder: The long night has its end.
